ALISO VIEJO, Calif., April 29, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- RxSight, Inc., today announced plans to participate in the upcoming Bank of America Healthcare Conference. Management is scheduled to participate in a fireside chat on Wednesday, May 13, 2026, at 3:00 p.m. Pacific Time. A live and archived webcast of the presentation will be available on the company’s investor relations website at[https://investors.rxsight.com/](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dxo2lQR01uGFv1zGgcVDBw7o_VmZKCBpH6w3N8gCGCFfhtnhWUqzHQbVBK1KFJ4bUNlAO2Fblk1Sc9Yn768otQpn3rJl6NJzO_IjGE74VZzFlWsKck9LdqoBYxvQvmjI) .


**About RxSight, Inc.**


RxSight, Inc. is an ophthalmic medical device company dedicated to providing high-quality customized vision to patients following cataract surgery. The RxSight® Light Adjustable Lens system, comprised of the RxSight Light Adjustable Lens® (LAL®/LAL+®, collectively the “LAL”), RxSight Light Delivery Device (LDD™) and accessories, is the first and only commercially available intraocular lens (IOL) technology that can be adjusted after surgery, enabling doctors to customize and deliver high-quality vision to patients after cataract surgery. Additional information about RxSight can be found at[www.rxsight.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=gdwfZx_RVyYHY0JSoB8UvjIceGvxA5-ND5mKW9igN_p-gJA7MlEqXQkEkWKsAJ-Rs3Iw8tOPC8_YAeRi6yIuRQ==) .
